title: Macquarrie
description:
Manufacturing | Melbourne, Victoria, Australia | Macquarrie specializes in diesel engine management solutions, telemetry solutions, and VK debarkers for milling operations. With over 70 years of experience, they provide a comprehensive range of products including controllers, displays, and monitoring instrumentation tailored for various industries such as mining, agriculture, and marine. The company prides itself on customer-focused service, offering local technical support, extensive after-sales assistance, and expert software programming. As the exclusive Australian agents for Valon Kone Oy, Macquarrie is recognized for its expertise in debarking solutions for sawmills.
The company headquarters is located in Unit 1/600 Lorimer Street, Port Melbourne, VIC 3207, Australia.
